<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Delete an API token.</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"delete"} path={"/v1/api-tokens/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Deletes an API token of the account that owns the API token in the request, and returns the deleted token.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

An API token can't delete itself. To delete the token you're calling with, use a different Admin API token.

Deleting a token affects any integrations that use that token. Make sure you update integrations that use a token you deleted.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
